name: Spinner
description: A spinner shows that something is loading when the time it takes is unknown. It announces its label once, politely, to screen readers.
whenToUse: For short waits of unknown length: loading a panel, saving, fetching results.

whenNotToUse.text: When progress is known, e.g. uploads.
When the page layout is known.

anatomy.name: Label
anatomy.description: Hidden text announced as a status.

behavior.text: role="status" announces the label once when it appears.
Spins slower for people who prefer reduced motion.

content: Say what is loading: “Loading orders”, not just “Loading”.

guidelines.do: Say what’s loading in the label.
guidelines.dont: Leave the default label for every spinner.
guidelines.why: Specific labels tell screen reader users what they’re waiting for.

guidelines.do: Use one spinner per loading area.
guidelines.dont: Show a spinner in every card at once.
guidelines.why: Many spinners are noisy visually and for screen readers.

guidelines.do: Show a Skeleton when the layout is known.
guidelines.dont: Replace a whole page with a spinner.
guidelines.why: Skeletons reduce layout jumps and feel faster.

aria.when: Always; the label is its text.

wcag.how: Loading is announced without moving focus.

notes: Mark the loading region aria-busy="true" until it’s ready.

examples.title: In a button
examples.code:
import { Button, Spinner } from '@ds/react';

<Button disabled><Spinner size="small" label="Saving" /> Saving…</Button>

examples.title: Busy region

components.name: Spinner
components.description:
A spinning indicator for loading that takes an unknown time. Announced once as a status.
For known progress, use Progress.

size.description: `small` inside buttons and fields, `medium` (default), `large` for page areas.

label.description: What is loading, announced politely, e.g. "Loading orders". Default "Loading".

--spinner-color.description: Solid fill for emphasized actions of a tone, e.g. filled buttons.

--spinner-track-color.description: Subtle tinted background for a tone, e.g. alerts, selected items, badges.

--spinner-duration.description: One turn of a repeating animation, e.g. a loading spinner.
